A monster whose canonical Chinese name contains Millennium in Yugi Muto's main reward candidate catalog. Excludes sealed Pieces, other generated-only cards, and Extra Deck monsters. Generated copies last for this combat.
THERMALVORTEX-MILLENNIUM_GOLD_EXCHANGE.d: On Summon, choose one affordable total-price offer, or pay nothing. Pay 10 to the power of n Gold to choose n Pieces. Upgraded prices are 30% lower (7, 70, 700...). Choose each Piece from the two Arms, two Legs, and Torso. You may choose the same type more than once.
THERMALVORTEX-MONSTER.title: Monster
THERMALVORTEX-MONSTER.description: Summoned onto your field, limited by monster slots. When attacked, the rightmost monster takes damage first. Monsters die at 0 HP.
THERMALVORTEX-FUSION_MONSTER.title: Fusion Monster
THERMALVORTEX-FUSION_MONSTER.description: A monster Summoned from the Extra Deck with matching Fusion Materials.
THERMALVORTEX-FUSION_CARD.title: Fusion Card
THERMALVORTEX-FUSION_CARD.description: A card whose name contains Fusion.
THERMALVORTEX-EXTRA_DECK.title: Extra Deck
THERMALVORTEX-EXTRA_DECK.description: A deck separate from the main deck that holds Fusion Monsters and is not used for drawing cards.
THERMALVORTEX-XYZ.title: Fusion Summon
THERMALVORTEX-XYZ.description: Use qualifying materials to Summon 1 Fusion Monster from the Extra Deck through a Fusion card or effect.
THERMALVORTEX-MATERIAL.title: Material
THERMALVORTEX-MATERIAL.description: A monster sacrificed for a Summon or card effect.
THERMALVORTEX-FUSION_MATERIAL.title: Fusion Material
THERMALVORTEX-FUSION_MATERIAL.descriptio: A Material used for a Fusion Summon.
THERMALVORTEX-NEGATE.title: Negate
THERMALVORTEX-NEGATE.description: Cancel the enemy action or effect specified on the card. The exact scope and timing are determined by that card's description.
THERMALVORTEX-REFLECT.title: Reflect
THERMALVORTEX-REFLECT.description: Negate an enemy's attack action and deal damage equal to that attack's total damage to the attacker. Multi-hit attacks use the combined damage of all hits.
THERMALVORTEX-WEAK.title: Weak
THERMALVORTEX-CONSUME_TRIGGER.title: Exhaust Trigger
THERMALVORTEX-CONSUME_TRIGGER.descriptio: An effect that triggers when this card is Exhausted.
THERMALVORTEX-DORMANT_MAGNETIC_FIELD.des: You cannot play Attacks. After the enemy turn ends, keep half of the remaining Block that would be cleared instead, and lose 1 stack of Dormant Magnetic Field.
THERMALVORTEX-CONTROL.title: Control
THERMALVORTEX-CONTROL.description: The controlling monster and controlled enemy always share HP. When the controlling monster takes damage, the controlled enemy loses the same amount of HP. The controlled enemy skips its actions. When the Control countdown ends, the controlling monster dies; Control ends early if it leaves the field.
THERMALVORTEX-CYBER_MONSTER.title: Cyber Monster
THERMALVORTEX-CYBER_MONSTER.description: A monster whose name contains Cyber.
THERMALVORTEX-DEVOUR.title: Devour
THERMALVORTEX-DEVOUR.description: Exhaust the target, add its current HP, max HP, and attack to the devourer, and inherit its copyable effects. Your own devour growth lasts for this combat. Piece Summon effects can be inherited; hand-held effects and Sleeping Tablet transitions cannot. Devouring does not immediately grant Summon rewards.
THERMALVORTEX-SANITY.title: Sanity Remains
THERMALVORTEX-SANITY.description: With no other target to Devour, stop without Exhausting itself.
THERMALVORTEX-SEALED_MILLENNIUM_PIECE.de: The Left Arm, Right Arm, Left Leg, Right Leg, and Torso. Win combat with all five types in hand. The field and other piles do not count, and no monster substitutes for a Piece. Pieces cost 0, have 1 HP, Exhaust, and cannot be upgraded.
THERMALVORTEX-MILLENNIUM_CARD.title: Millennium Card
THERMALVORTEX-MILLENNIUM_CARD.descriptio: A card whose name contains Millennium.
THERMALVORTEX-MILLENNIUM_MONSTER.title: Millennium Monster
THERMALVORTEX-MILLENNIUM_MONSTER.descrip: A monster card whose name contains Millennium.
THERMALVORTEX-MILLENNIUM_POWER.title: Millennium Power
THERMALVORTEX-MILLENNIUM_POWER.descripti: A Power whose name contains Millennium.
THERMALVORTEX-MILLENNIUM_COUNT.title: Millennium Count
THERMALVORTEX-MILLENNIUM_COUNT.descripti:
Millennium cards in your hand + Millennium monsters on your field + distinct Millennium Powers you have. Card plays and Summons use the count from before the action; Fusion locks it before paying materials. Cards leaving your hand during the action still count, and the newly Summoned monster adds no extra count. Powers with the same name count as 1, regardless of stacks.{HasCurrentMillenniumCount:
Current Millennium Count: {CurrentMillenniumCount}.|}
THERMALVORTEX-MILLENNIUM_CROSS_RULE.desc: Millennium Cross cannot be played and Exodia cannot be Summoned when your monster field is full.
THERMALVORTEX-MILLENNIUM_UNIQUE_HAND.des: Applies once per Piece type held in hand when playing a Millennium Card or successfully Summoning one of the five Millennium-series Extra Deck monsters. Snapshot the hand before play, excluding the played entity; for Extra Deck Summons, snapshot after paying materials and before Summon rewards. Pieces spent as materials do not count. After the card and Summon resolve, Sift, draw, gain Energy, then Fuse, once for a play and its own entry. Newly acquired Pieces apply from the next play or Summon. No per-turn limit. The Torso provides continuous Retain instead.
THERMALVORTEX-MILLENNIUM_CONTROL.title: Millennium Sift
THERMALVORTEX-MILLENNIUM_CONTROL.descrip: Look at the specified number of cards on top of your Draw pile. Discard any number, including zero. If needed, preserve the existing order and shuffle the Discard pile onto the bottom. Look at all available cards if there are too few. Refill only once per Sift; do not reshuffle cards discarded by that same Sift. Keep the remaining cards in order.
THERMALVORTEX-MILLENNIUM_FUSION.title: Millennium Fuse
THERMALVORTEX-MILLENNIUM_FUSION.descript: You may Fusion Summon using legal hand and field materials, with all conditions of upgraded Fusion. You may skip. Playing a card and Summoning that card share one opportunity, even with multiple hand, field, copied, or inherited sources. A newly Summoned monster is a new event and can trigger again if a field Right Leg effect remains.
